source.title: SubD Workflow: Modeling a Simple Object
source.creator: Blind Rhino

analysis.study_scope: 0 to 300 seconds covering radial array setup, profile lobe shaping, cavity extrusion, topology cleanup, and bolt pocket sub-patch setup.

episodes.problem: Setting up parametric 5-fold radial symmetry for pump housing.
episodes.observed_fact: A 5-vertex circle is trimmed to a sector and linked to a 72-degree rotated Empty via an Array modifier.
episodes.instructor_claim: Using Object Offset targeting a rotated Empty maintains editable 5-fold radial symmetry.
episodes.interpretation: Modular sector editing ensures identical housing lobes.
episodes.hypothesis: Combining mirror and array modifiers minimizes vertex manipulation.
episodes.reference_evidence: Array modifier Object Offset targeting rotated Empty.
episodes.modeling_decision: Construct a 1/5th wedge slice with Mirror and Array modifiers.
episodes.visible_action: Creates circle, trims verts, adds Mirror and Array targeting rotated Empty.
episodes.spoken_reason: Automate radial repetition across all five lobes.
episodes.failure: Unmerged seam vertices at wedge boundaries.
episodes.correction: Enabled Merge option in Array modifier.
episodes.alternatives: Manual spin duplicate or linked duplicate instances.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use Array modifier targeting a rotated Empty for non-destructive radial symmetry.

episodes.problem: Shaping peripheral lobe curvature without distorting circular boundaries.
episodes.observed_fact: Vertices are positioned along an overlapping circular guide mesh using Knife and transform tools.
episodes.instructor_claim: Guide geometry maintains precise outer circular boundaries.
episodes.interpretation: Non-rendering guides prevent boundary deformation during manual retopology.
episodes.hypothesis: Manual vertex placement without reference leads to uneven surface curvature under SubD.
episodes.reference_evidence: Separate circle object used as visual boundary template.
episodes.modeling_decision: Align profile vertices against guide mesh before 3D extrusion.
episodes.visible_action: Adds guide circle, adjusts lobe vertices, cuts quad edge paths with Knife tool.
episodes.spoken_reason: Maintain exact circular curvature for outer housing wall.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Evenly distributed quad perimeter following guide radius.
episodes.transferable_principle: Use auxiliary guide geometry to align boundary vertices on complex curved profiles.

episodes.problem: Extruding 2D profile into 3D volume with stepped side recesses.
episodes.observed_fact: Sector faces are extruded on Z axis, inset, and translated inward.
episodes.instructor_claim: Insetting before depressing geometry generates necessary corner support loops.
episodes.interpretation: Pre-insetting prevents pole creation on vertical wall step transitions.
episodes.hypothesis: Extruding faces directly without inset produces sharp shading pinching.
episodes.reference_evidence: Face Inset operation preceding inward Z translation.
episodes.modeling_decision: Extrude housing height, inset face region, and depress pocket floor.
episodes.visible_action: Extruding base downward, selecting face group, applying inset, moving inward.
episodes.spoken_reason: Build wall thickness and recessed side feature.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Stepped geometry framed by perimeter quad loops.
episodes.transferable_principle: Inset planar regions before pushing depth to establish perimeter boundary loops.

episodes.problem: Eliminating interior cavity triangles to prevent subdivision artifacts.
episodes.observed_fact: Diagonal edges are dissolved and quads are routed parallel to cavity steps.
episodes.instructor_claim: Clean quad layout avoids shading distortion under Subdivision Surface modifier.
episodes.interpretation: Orienting quad flow parallel to step walls isolates planar floors.
episodes.hypothesis: Non-quad geometry on recessed floors creates poles under subdivision.
episodes.reference_evidence: Vertex dissolve and edge routing inside cavity base.
episodes.modeling_decision: Dissolve diagonal edges and re-route clean quad grid.
episodes.visible_action: Dissolves vertices, merges points, connects quad paths with J/F keys.
episodes.spoken_reason: Ensure cavity interior consists of continuous quads.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Structured quad flow inside cavity without triangles or n-gons.
episodes.failure: Stray vertex caused pinched corner shading.
episodes.correction: Dissolved stray vertex and re-merged edge path.
episodes.transferable_principle: Route quad flow parallel to wall boundaries inside recessed cavities.

episodes.problem: Constructing cross-shaped bolt recess on top housing lobe surface.
episodes.observed_fact: A separate plane is subdivided, extruded into cross shape, and inset.
episodes.instructor_claim: Isolated patch modeling keeps base housing topology clean during detail creation.
episodes.interpretation: Developing local cutouts independently avoids cluttering main mesh loops.
episodes.hypothesis: Knife-cutting complex cross shapes directly onto housing causes messy loop propagation.
episodes.reference_evidence: Isolated cross mesh created above housing surface.
episodes.modeling_decision: Model cross cutout as detached planar patch before integration.
episodes.visible_action: Adds plane, subdivides, extrudes arms into cross shape, insets border.
episodes.spoken_reason: Form clean cross geometry independently prior to surface merging.
episodes.topology_surface_effect: Isolated cross-shaped quad patch ready for surface stitching.
episodes.transferable_principle: Build complex local surface cutouts as isolated planar patches before joining main geometry.
